rationale: The translation exactly preserves the algebraic content of equations (3.3), (3.6), and (4.1) after renaming the current and next iterates. It drops nonsingularity, iteration-sequence dependence, algorithm provenance, precision assumptions, rounding-error bounds, and exceptional-value assumptions. Those omissions enlarge the domain of the exact identity rather than weaken or alter its conclusion. Consequently the translation specializes to every paper case, while the paper's scoped statement does not establish the full generalized proposition.
